concepts.title: Harness Sync Engine
concepts.description: Bash engine that syncs harness domains from upstream while preserving fork renames, substitutions, and protected files.
concepts.notes: scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh | 3366 lines, bash, set -e | 10 subcommands dispatched by case on $1: init status version diff sync manifest rollback conflicts releases help | check_dependencies requires curl + node, exits 1 if missing; help path skips dependency check | migrate_metadata_to_root runs before every non-help command: copies .claude/.harness-manifest.yml/.harness-sync.json/.harness-backup/.harness-patches to repo root when root copy absent, else repoints vars back to legacy paths | root paths: .harness-sync.json .harness-backup .harness-patches .harness-manifest.yml .harness-manifest.schema.json | TMP_DIR=/tmp/claude-harness-sync-$$ removed by cleanup() on EXIT trap | load_manifest parses YAML via python3 + PyYAML into $TMP_DIR/manifest.json; missing python3 or PyYAML or YAML parse error sets HAS_MANIFEST=false and prints 'Falling back to legacy sync' (never fatal) | validate_manifest requires manifest_version matching ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ and identity sub-fields; status/version/diff/sync exit 1 on validation failure, init treats it non-fatal | do_sync flags: --dry-run --version <tag> --latest --scope <csv> --no-placeholders --skip-preflight --generate-patches; unknown args silently shifted (no error) | do_sync returns 1 when HAS_MANIFEST!=true unless --dry-run (dry-run warns and uses legacy .claude-only scope) | manifest_version 1.1 or greater sets USE_ROOT_PATHS=true (root-relative rename/protected paths); 1.0 uses domain-relative | JSON access via node -e inline scripts (json_get/json_set/json_update/json_array_prepend); YAML only via python3 | apply_substitutions builds sed commands from identity ({{KEY}}->value) merged with explicit substitutions (explicit wins), sorted longest-key-first, applied in one sed -i invocation; GNU vs BSD sed branch on `sed --version | grep GNU` | resolve_rename checks exact file rename first, then directory renames by trailing-slash prefix match (file rename wins) | is_protected hardcodes .harness-sync.json .harness-manifest.yml .sync-exclude .sync-exclude.default .harness-backup* then glob-matches merged manifest protected[] + .claude/.sync-exclude, and ALSO substring-matches every pattern (*pattern*) for .sync-exclude back-compat | .claude/.sync-exclude and .claude/.sync-exclude.default do not exist in this repo; merged pattern set comes from manifest only | run_preflight checks (a) path traversal in local_rel, (b) unreplaced manifest tokens via scan_unreplaced_tokens, (c) protected-file collisions on both upstream and local paths; returns 1 and aborts sync on any error | generate_patch emits unified diffs with git-style a//b/$CURRENT_DOMAIN/<local_rel> labels, new files diffed against /dev/null; patch filenames flatten / to __ ; APPLY_ORDER.md written per version dir | update_sync_metadata records last_sync_commit, last_sync_version, last_sync_timestamp and prepends to sync_history capped at 10 | do_diff uses `declare -A dir_rename_counts` (line 1560) which requires bash 4+; fails on macOS system bash 3.2 with 'declare: -A: invalid option' | DOC DRIFT: show_help says 'Without a manifest, the script uses legacy file-level copy behavior' while do_sync returns 1 without a manifest for any non-dry-run invocation | DOC DRIFT: manifest sync.substitution_extensions and schema default list .md .json .yml .yaml .sh .py .ts .mjs .txt .toml, but apply_all_substitutions never reads that key and uses a hardcoded case list that adds *.bib and *.cff | DOC DRIFT: run_preflight scope-violation error message says 'files outside .claude/ would be modified' although sync is multi-domain | UNKNOWN: whether sync.auto_substitute, sync.backup, and sync.conflict_strategy are read anywhere — no reference to those keys was found outside the manifest and schema

concepts.title: Harness Manifest Schema
concepts.description: JSON Schema and repo manifest declaring fork identity, renames, protected paths, and sync preferences.
concepts.notes: .harness-manifest.schema.json | JSON Schema, additionalProperties false at root | root required: manifest_version, identity | top-level properties: manifest_version, identity, substitutions, renames, protected, replaced, sync (7) | identity.required: PROJECT_NAME PROJECT_REPO PROJECT_SHORT GITHUB_ORG TICKET_PREFIX MAIN_BRANCH (6) | .harness-manifest.yml declares 28 identity keys, all unresolved {{TOKEN}} values in this upstream repo | sync object (additionalProperties false) has 5 keys: sync_scope, auto_substitute, backup, conflict_strategy, substitution_extensions | sync_scope items enum: .claude/ .gemini/ .codex/ .cursor/ .agents/ dark-factory/ ; minItems 1, uniqueItems | conflict_strategy enum: upstream-wins, local-wins, prompt, three-way | schema is NOT executed against the manifest at runtime — validate_manifest in scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh reimplements a subset of the checks in bash (manifest_version pattern + identity required fields); MANIFEST_SCHEMA var is assigned but no JSON-Schema validator is invoked | protected/replaced are string arrays; replaced files are skipped with a 'Skipped (replaced)' notice per manifest comments | DOC DRIFT: schema describes sync.backup as 'Current: .claude/.harness-backup/. Planned (SAW-34): .harness-backup/ at repo root' but scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh already defaults BACKUP_DIR to repo-root .harness-backup with .claude/ only as legacy fallback | DOC DRIFT: schema says release domains docs/, scripts/, patterns_library/ 'will be rejected'; get_sync_scope and the --scope parser only emit a [WARN] 'Ignoring unknown sync domain' and continue | .harness-manifest.yml header points to docs/HARNESS_MANIFEST_SCHEMA.md (file exists) | UNKNOWN: whether any tooling validates the manifest against this schema outside the bash reimplementation

concepts.title: Multi-Domain Sync Scope Resolution
concepts.description: How the sync engine resolves which harness domains to process from the manifest, CLI override, and allowlist.
concepts.notes: get_sync_scope() in scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh, called by do_sync after load_manifest | ALLOWED_DOMAINS hardcoded array: .claude .gemini .codex .cursor .agents dark-factory (6) | get_sync_scope does NOT use the parsed manifest JSON — it re-reads .harness-manifest.yml line by line with grep/sed, entering on /^\s*sync_scope:/ and consuming following lines starting with '-' | each item is stripped of quotes and trailing slash then matched exactly against ALLOWED_DOMAINS; non-matches print [WARN] 'Ignoring unknown sync domain: <d>' and are dropped | empty result falls back to SYNC_SCOPE=(.claude) | --scope <csv> in do_sync replaces SYNC_SCOPE for that invocation only and does not rewrite the manifest; invalid entries warn 'Ignoring unknown scope'; if every entry is invalid do_sync prints 'No valid domains in --scope' and returns 1 | domains processed sequentially in a loop; per-domain globals DOMAIN_TMP and DOMAIN_DIR and CURRENT_DOMAIN drive compare_file_with_paths, generate_patch, and preflight token lookups | SYNC_TIMESTAMP reset to empty before the loop so every domain in one run shares one backup timestamp | patches version directory created once outside the domain loop so later domains do not wipe earlier domains' patches | manifest_version 1.1+ makes renames/protected/replaced root-relative so one manifest can address every domain | this repo's .harness-manifest.yml enumerates all six domains in sync_scope | UNKNOWN: behavior when a domain listed in sync_scope is absent from the fetched upstream tree — enumerate_upstream_files suppresses find errors with 2>/dev/null and returns nothing

concepts.title: Test: Fork Sync Compatibility
concepts.description: Runs the sync script against rendertrust and keryk-ai fork fixtures; currently aborts before reporting results.
concepts.notes: tests/test-fork-sync.sh | SAW-9 | 30221 bytes, set -e, mktemp workdir removed by EXIT trap | 4 sections: 1 RenderTrust fork, 2 Keryk AI fork, 3 Cross-Fork Validation, 4 Schema & Fixture Integrity | 56 assert_ call sites; helpers assert_contains and assert_exit_code | PROVES FAILURE: it is one of only two suites asserting a non-zero exit — assert_exit_code 1 for `status` on a manifest missing identity, and assert_exit_code 1 for a malformed manifest_version | PROVES SUCCESS: init creates config, manifest counts (rendertrust 0 renames / 2 protected; keryk-ai 4 renames / 4 protected), dry-run exits 0, rename resolution writes ui-engineer.md and api-engineer.md and payment-patterns/ instead of upstream names, 'Skipping protected' emitted | STATUS: FAILS on this machine. Two independent causes observed. (1) do_diff uses `declare -A` (scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh:1560) which bash 3.2 rejects with 'declare: -A: invalid option', so 7 diff-related assertions FAIL (PROTECTED label, hooks-config.json, team-config.json, ui-engineer, api-engineer, payment-patterns). (2) Test 2.5 cats <tmp>/ka-protected/.claude/settings.local.json, which does not exist — tests/fixtures/sync/keryk-ai/.claude/ contains no settings.local.json although the keryk-ai manifest lists it under protected — and `set -e` aborts the script there, so the Results block never prints | recorded as a known fixture/environment gap, not a defect to repair | invoked by scripts/pre-release-check.sh in its tests/test-*.sh loop, where the missing 'ALL...PASS' string makes it report 'FAILED'

concepts.title: Test: Manifest Init Wizard

concepts.notes: tests/test-manifest-init.sh | SAW-12 | 17127 bytes, set -e, mktemp workdir + EXIT trap | 14 numbered test sections, 57 assert_ call sites | exercises do_manifest_init, read_team_config_identity, scan_for_additional_substitutions, read_sync_exclude_patterns, generate_manifest_yaml | PROVES SUCCESS ONLY: every assert_exit_code in this file expects 0 — `manifest init --dry-run` exits 0, `manifest init --yes` exits 0, and init exits 0 even with no team-config.json | no assertion in this suite expects a non-zero exit or an aborted run | degraded paths are checked by OUTPUT TEXT rather than exit status: 'No team-config.json' warning, 'incomplete fields' warning, and unresolved {{PROJECT_NAME}}/{{TICKET_PREFIX}} being written through as literal placeholders | asserts generated manifest_version is "1.1", identity values are lifted from team-config.json, sync_scope section is emitted and includes .claude/, 'Detecting harness domains' and 'Found:' appear | asserts protected[] absorbs settings.local.json, hooks-config.json, and the glob agents/custom-*.md from .sync-exclude | asserts substitutions section carries GITHUB_ORG | config VALUES for the fixture project are asserted literally in the test file

concepts.notes: tests/test-manifest-loader.sh | SAW-6 | 13131 bytes, smallest of the nine suites, set -e, mktemp + EXIT trap | 12 numbered test sections, 28 assert_ call sites (assert_pass/assert_contains/assert_exit_code) | PROVES FAILURE BY MESSAGE, NOT BY EXIT CODE: asserts validator strings 'missing required field: manifest_version', 'must match pattern X.Y', 'missing required field: PROJECT_REPO', 'missing required field: TICKET_PREFIX', 'missing required field: identity' | the only assert_exit_code in the file is `assert_exit_code 0 0` for help in legacy mode — no non-zero exit is ever asserted here, so it does not prove that an invalid manifest actually blocks a command | PROVES GRACEFUL DEGRADATION: invalid YAML asserts output contains 'Falling back to legacy', and init/help are asserted to work with no manifest at all | asserts summary formatting exactly: 'Manifest found: 1 renames, 3 substitutions, 3 protected patterns' and the all-zero variant for empty sections | asserts protected count folds protected[] + replaced[] into one number (3 = protected + replaced) | asserts .harness-manifest.yml itself shows as EXCLUDED in diff | re-run for regression by tests/test-substitutions.sh, which asserts this suite exits 0

concepts.title: Test: Preflight Safety Check

concepts.title: setup-template.sh
concepts.description: Interactive wizard that replaces template placeholders repo-wide when a new project is created from the template.
concepts.notes: scripts/setup-template.sh | 8571 bytes, #!/usr/bin/env bash, set -euo pipefail | run once after creating a repo from the template: bash scripts/setup-template.sh | prompts interactively, prints a summary, then requires a y/Y answer to 'Proceed? (y/N)' — any other answer prints 'Aborted.' and exits 1 | _sed_inplace helper branches on `sed --version | grep GNU` to pick GNU `sed -i` vs BSD `sed -i ''` | REPLACEMENTS is a declare -a of 30 OLD|NEW pairs applied in order, longest/most-specific first, and a pair is skipped when OLD equals NEW | 4 of the 30 are derived rather than prompted: GITHUB_REPO_URL, TICKET_PREFIX_LOWER, AUTHOR_INITIALS, HARNESS_VERSION | replacement targets are found by `find` over these names: *.md *.json *.yml *.yaml *.sh *.py *.txt *.toml *.bib *.cff *.mjs *.ts NOTICE LICENSE CODEOWNERS .env.template .gitignore, excluding */.git/* and */node_modules/* | files are rewritten via xargs -0 _sed_inplace with an unanchored s|OLD|NEW|g, so a placeholder occurring inside another string is also rewritten | after the pass it greps for surviving {{[A-Z_]*}} tokens across a NARROWER include set (*.md *.json *.yml *.yaml *.sh *.cff *.bib) and reports them; .toml .ts .mjs .txt .py NOTICE LICENSE CODEOWNERS .env.template .gitignore are substituted but never re-scanned, so leftovers there are not reported | this script is the origin of the placeholder names that .harness-manifest.yml identity must mirror; the manifest documents 28 identity keys against these 30 replacements | scripts/pre-release-check.sh section 3 asserts this file exists | this repo is still in template state — its own sources contain unresolved {{...}} tokens

concepts.title: pre-release-check.sh
concepts.description: Automates the pre-release checklist across code quality, docs, template compatibility, compatibility, and git state.
concepts.notes: scripts/pre-release-check.sh | 7655 bytes, set -euo pipefail, cds to PROJECT_ROOT | usage: ./scripts/pre-release-check.sh [version]; version defaults to the literal UNSET and is only echoed, never validated | automates docs/release/PRE-RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md | 5 sections: 1 Code Quality Gates, 2 Documentation Completeness, 3 Template Compatibility, 4 Backward Compatibility, 5 Git State | three outcome counters via check_pass / check_fail / check_warn | exit contract: any FAIL prints 'RELEASE BLOCKED' and exits 1; zero fails with warnings prints 'RELEASE READY WITH WARNINGS' and exits 0; clean prints 'ALL CHECKS PASSED' and exits 0 — warnings never block | section 1 runs `bash -n scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh`, greps for '<<<<<<' conflict markers, then loops every tests/test-*.sh | a suite counts as passing ONLY if its output matches grep -q 'ALL.*PASS'; anything else is check_fail, so a suite that aborts early is reported as FAILED | tests/test-fork-sync.sh currently aborts before printing results and therefore fails this gate | PORTABILITY: the test loop calls `timeout 120` and `grep -oP`, both GNU-only — neither is present on stock macOS, so the loop misbehaves there (timeout: command not found) | section 3 greps harness files for hardcoded project values (warn only) and requires scripts/setup-template.sh to exist | section 4 checks .harness-manifest.schema.json and the examples/manifests entries, all as warnings not failures | section 5 fails when not on main, warns on a dirty working tree, warns when SAW feature branches remain

concepts.title: generate-changelog.sh
concepts.description: Generates a structured changelog between two git refs, categorizing harness file changes for release notes.

concepts.title: install-prompts.sh

concepts.notes: scripts/install-prompts.sh | 7880 bytes, set -e | three modes parsed from argv: default per-user Claude Code install, --team for in-project shared agents, --augment for Augment Code; --help prints usage | header states it installs 11 agent prompts | copies with `cp -v "$CLAUDE_AGENTS_DIR"/*.md` into the user agents dir for the Claude path and `cp -v "$AUGMENT_AGENTS_DIR"/*.md` for the Augment path | also copies .claude/hooks/*.sh into a user hooks dir, suppressed with `2>/dev/null || true` so a missing hooks directory is silent and non-fatal | destination directories are user-scoped paths derived inside the script; source is the repo's .claude/ tree via SCRIPT_DIR/REPO_ROOT | contains unresolved {{PROJECT_SHORT}} placeholders in its own header, so it is itself a setup-template.sh substitution target | overwrites existing agent files in the destination without a diff or backup step | UNKNOWN: whether the count of agent .md files actually shipped matches the 11 stated in the header — the copy is a wildcard, not an enumerated list

concepts.title: apply-workflow.sh
concepts.description: Integrates the SAFe agentic workflow template into an existing project, prompting for the AI agent provider.
concepts.notes: scripts/apply-workflow.sh | 6664 bytes, set -e | NOT executable — mode 644, unlike the other 9 shell scripts in scripts/ which are 755; must be invoked as `bash scripts/apply-workflow.sh` | integrates the harness template into an existing target project rather than bootstrapping a new repo from the template | TEMPLATE_DIR is `dirname $0` (the scripts/ directory itself, not the repo root) and TARGET_DIR is hardcoded to '.' — the current working directory is the install target | log_error echoes and then exits 1, so any error path is fatal | prompts the operator to choose an AI agent provider, presenting Claude Code as the recommended fully-automated option | carries unresolved {{PROJECT_SHORT}} placeholders in its own strings, so it is a setup-template.sh substitution target | overlaps in purpose with scripts/setup-template.sh (new repo from template) — this one targets an already-existing project | UNKNOWN: the full provider list offered and what each branch copies, and whether the non-executable mode is intentional

concepts.title: reorganize-docs.sh
concepts.description: One-time migration that restructures repository documentation per the repository reorganization plan.
concepts.notes: scripts/reorganize-docs.sh | 11100 bytes, largest of the doc-maintenance scripts, set -e | implements docs/REPOSITORY-REORGANIZATION-PLAN.md (file exists) | guards on being run from the repository root: exits with an error unless both README.md and .git are present in the working directory | moves documentation files into their reorganized locations under docs/ | one-time historical migration, already applied to this repo — re-running is not part of any routine workflow | paired with scripts/update-doc-references.sh and scripts/fix-remaining-doc-references.sh, which repair inbound links after the moves | UNKNOWN: whether the script is idempotent if re-run after the migration has already landed | UNKNOWN: whether it uses git mv or plain mv, and therefore whether rename history is preserved

concepts.title: update-doc-references.sh
concepts.description: Rewrites links to documentation files that moved during the repository reorganization.
concepts.notes: scripts/update-doc-references.sh | 5904 bytes, set -e | companion to scripts/reorganize-docs.sh; part of docs/REPOSITORY-REORGANIZATION-PLAN.md | defines an update_file_references() helper taking a file path and rewriting the old documentation paths to their new locations | runs after the moves, so it depends on reorganize-docs.sh having already executed | leaves residue that scripts/fix-remaining-doc-references.sh exists specifically to clean up — the two form a sequence, not alternatives | one-time historical migration script, not part of a routine workflow | UNKNOWN: the full mapping of old to new paths it applies | UNKNOWN: whether it is idempotent on already-updated files

concepts.title: fix-remaining-doc-references.sh
concepts.description: Cleanup pass fixing documentation references missed by the main reorganization update script.
concepts.notes: scripts/fix-remaining-doc-references.sh | 3145 bytes, smallest script in scripts/, set -e | third and last stage of the doc reorganization sequence, after reorganize-docs.sh and update-doc-references.sh | operates on a HARDCODED FILES array of 8 paths rather than discovering files: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/onboarding/DAY-1-CHECKLIST.md, docs/onboarding/META-PROMPTS-FOR-USERS.md, docs/onboarding/USER-JOURNEY-VALIDATION-REPORT.md, docs/onboarding/{{TICKET_PREFIX}}-326-COMPLETION-SUMMARY.md, docs/team/PLANNING-AGENT-META-PROMPT.md, patterns_library/database/rls-migration.md | each entry is guarded by `if [ -f "$file" ]`, so missing paths are skipped silently and the run still succeeds | one array entry embeds the literal {{TICKET_PREFIX}} placeholder in its path, so that entry only resolves after scripts/setup-template.sh has substituted the repo — in template state it never matches and is always skipped | one-time historical migration script | UNKNOWN: which specific reference strings it rewrites inside each file

concepts.title: generalize-onboarding-docs.sh
concepts.description: Replaces hardcoded project references in onboarding docs with template placeholders, backing up each file first.
concepts.notes: scripts/generalize-onboarding-docs.sh | 3405 bytes, #!/usr/bin/env bash, set -euo pipefail | runs the INVERSE of scripts/setup-template.sh: turns concrete project values back into {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens so the docs are template-ready | operates on a fixed brace-expansion list of 5 files under docs/onboarding/: DAY-1-CHECKLIST.md, SOCIAL-MEDIA-SETUP.md, AGENT-SETUP-GUIDE.md, META-PROMPTS-FOR-USERS.md, USER-JOURNEY-VALIDATION-REPORT.md | before editing it copies each existing file to <file>.bak; the .bak files are left on disk and never cleaned up by this script | each file is guarded by `if [ -f "$file" ]`, so missing targets are skipped without failing | one-time template-preparation script, already applied — not part of a routine workflow | UNKNOWN: the exact set of hardcoded strings mapped to which placeholder tokens | UNKNOWN: whether re-running over already-generalized files is a no-op or double-substitutes

concepts.title: generalize_commands.py
concepts.description: Python utility that adds template notices and placeholder syntax to Claude Code command markdown files.
concepts.notes: scripts/generalize_commands.py | 6659 bytes, #!/usr/bin/env python3, imports os, re, pathlib | the ONLY non-shell file in scripts/ and the only one using snake_case rather than kebab-case | mode 644, not executable | rewrites .claude/commands/*.md to use template placeholders instead of hardcoded values | BROKEN AS SHIPPED: COMMANDS_DIR is a hardcoded absolute path built from unresolved template tokens — Path("/home/{{AUTHOR_HANDLE}}/Projects/{{PROJECT_REPO}}/.claude/commands") — so in template state it points at a literal directory containing brace tokens and cannot resolve; it is not derived from __file__ or any CLI argument | add_template_notice() inserts a TEMPLATE_NOTICE banner after the frontmatter, locating it by content.split("---", 2), and returns the content unchanged if the marker is already present (idempotent on that step) | the frontmatter split assumes the file opens with a --- delimited block; a command file without frontmatter would have its first two --- occurrences treated as the block | one-time template-preparation utility, superseded in practice by scripts/setup-template.sh which handles substitution repo-wide | UNKNOWN: whether this script was ever run against a resolved path, and whether the {{...}} tokens in COMMANDS_DIR are intended to be substituted by setup-template.sh (which does include *.py in its find list, so they would be)
